original: Optimization for a frequent special case. The configuration parser (and a few others) reads the stream one byte at a time. All the memcpy, pool clearing etc. imposes a huge overhead in that case. In most cases, we can just take that single byte directly from the read buffer. original: This is a very efficient serialization and especially efficient * deserialization framework. The idea is just to concatenate all sub- * structures and strings into a single buffer while preserving proper * member alignment. Pointers will be replaced by the respective data * offsets in the buffer when that target that it pointed to gets * serialized, i.e. appended to the data buffer written so far. * * Hence, deserialization can be simply done by copying the buffer and * adjusting the pointers. No fine-grained allocation and copying is * necessary.
pt: este e a muito eficiente serializacao and especialmente eficiente * deserialization estrutura. The ideia e apenas para concatenate todos sub- * estruturas and strings em a unico buffer enquanto preserving adequado * membro alinhamento. ponteiros sera substituido por the respective dados * offsets em the buffer quando esse alvo esse ele apontado para obtem * serializado, eu.e. anexado para the dados buffer escrito ate agora. * * portanto, deserialization pode ser simplesmente feito por copiando the buffer and * adjusting the ponteiros. No bom-grained alocacao and copiando e * necessario.

original: The maximum length of a transaction name. The Berkeley DB backend generates transaction names from a sequence expressed as a base 36 number with a maximum of MAX_KEY_SIZE (currently 200) bytes. The FSFS backend generates transaction names of the form <rev>-<base 36-number> where the base 36 number is a sequence value with a maximum length of MAX_KEY_SIZE bytes. The maximum length is 212, but use 220 just to have some extra space: 10 -> 32 bit revision number 1 -> '-' 200 -> 200 digit base 36 number 1 -> '\0'
pt: The maximo comprimento de a transaction nome. The Berkeley DB backend gera transaction nomes de a sequencia expressed como a base 36 numero com a maximo de MAX_KEY_SIZE (atualmente 200) bytes. The FSFS backend gera transaction nomes de the forma <revisao>-<base 36-numero> onde the base 36 numero e a sequencia valor com a maximo comprimento de MAX_KEY_SIZE bytes. The maximo comprimento e 212, mas usar 220 apenas para tem alguns extra espaco: 10 -> 32 bit revisao numero 1 -> '-' 200 -> 200 digito base 36 numero 1 -> '\0'

original: Return a canonicalized version of a filesystem PATH, allocated in POOL. While the filesystem API is pretty flexible about the incoming paths (they must be UTF-8 with '/' as separators, but they don't have to begin with '/', and multiple contiguous '/'s are ignored) we want any paths that are physically stored in the underlying database to look consistent. Specifically, absolute filesystem paths should begin with '/', and all redundant and trailing '/' characters be removed.
pt: retornar a canonicalized versao de a sistema de arquivos PATH, alocado em POOL. enquanto the sistema de arquivos API e pretty flexivel sobre the entrante caminhos (eles deve ser UTF-8 com '/' como separators, mas eles do't tem de inicio com '/', and multiplo contiguous '/'s sao ignorado) nos querer qualquer caminhos esse sao physically guardado em the subjacente banco de dados para olhar consistente. especificamente, absoluto sistema de arquivos caminhos deve inicio com '/', and todos redundant and final '/' caracteres ser removido.

original: Return whether INFO1 and INFO2 are equal in *IS_EQUAL. CONSIDER_INHERITANCE determines how the rangelists in the two hashes are compared for equality. If CONSIDER_INHERITANCE is FALSE, then the start and end revisions of the svn_merge_range_t's being compared are the only factors considered when determining equality. e.g. '/trunk: 1,3-4*,5' == '/trunk: 1,3-5' If CONSIDER_INHERITANCE is TRUE, then the inheritability of the svn_merge_range_t's is also considered and must be the same for two otherwise identical ranges to be judged equal. e.g. '/trunk: 1,3-4*,5' != '/trunk: 1,3-5' '/trunk: 1,3-4*,
pt: retornar se INFO1 and INFO2 sao igual em *IS_EQUAL. CONSIDER_INHERITANCE determina como the rangelists em the dois hashes sao comparado para igualdade. se CONSIDER_INHERITANCE e FALSE, entao the inicio and fim revisions de the svn_merge_range_t's sendo comparado sao the somente factors considerado quando determinando igualdade. e.g. '/tronco: 1,3-4*,5' == '/tronco: 1,3-5' se CONSIDER_INHERITANCE e TRUE, entao the herdabilidade de the svn_merge_range_t's e tambem considerado and deve ser o mesmo para dois caso contrario identico intervalos para ser judged igual. e.g. '/tronco: 1,3-4*,5'!= '/tronco: 1,3-5' '/tronco: 1,3-4*,

original: Make a shallow (ie, mergeinfos are not duped, or altered at all; keys share storage) copy of IN_CATALOG in *OUT_CATALOG, removing PREFIX_PATH (which is an absolute path) from the beginning of each key in the catalog (each of which is also an absolute path). It is illegal for any key to not start with PREFIX_PATH. The new hash and temporary values are allocated in POOL. (This is useful for making the return value from svn_ra_get_mergeinfo relative to the session root, say.)
pt: fazer a raso (ie, mergeinfos nao sao duped, ou altered em todos; chaves compartilhar armazenamento) copiar de IN_CATALOG em *OUT_CATALOG, removendo PREFIX_PATH (que e an absoluto caminho) do inicio de cada chave em the catalog (cada de que e tambem an absoluto caminho). e ilegal para qualquer chave para not inicio com PREFIX_PATH. The novo hash and temporario valores sao alocado em POOL. (este e util para fazendo the retornar valor de svn_ra_get_mergeinfo relativo para the sessao raiz, dizer.)

original: Make a shallow (ie, mergeinfos are not duped, or altered at all; though keys are reallocated) copy of IN_CATALOG in *OUT_CATALOG, adding PREFIX_PATH to the beginning of each key in the catalog. pt: fazer a raso (ie, mergeinfos nao sao duped, ou altered em todos; embora chaves sao reallocated) copiar de IN_CATALOG em *OUT_CATALOG, adicionando PREFIX_PATH para the inicio de cada chave em the catalog. The novo hash chaves sao alocado em RESULT_POOL. SCRATCH_POOL e usado para qualquer temporario alocacoes.

original: Create a string representation of MERGEINFO in *OUTPUT, allocated in POOL. Unlike svn_mergeinfo_to_string(), NULL MERGEINFO is tolerated and results in *OUTPUT set to "\n". If SVN_DEBUG is true, then NULL or empty MERGEINFO causes *OUTPUT to be set to an appropriate newline terminated string. If PREFIX is not NULL then prepend PREFIX to each line in *OUTPUT. Any relative merge source paths in MERGEINFO are converted to absolute paths in *OUTPUT.
pt: criacao a string representacao de MERGEINFO em *OUTPUT, alocado em POOL. Unlike svn_mergeinfo_to_string(), NULL MERGEINFO e tolerated and resultados em *OUTPUT definir para "\n". se SVN_DEBUG e verdadeiro, entao NULL ou vazio MERGEINFO causa *OUTPUT para ser definir para an apropriado quebra de linha encerrado string. se PREFIX nao e NULL entao prepend PREFIX para cada linha em *OUTPUT. qualquer relativo mesclar fonte caminhos em MERGEINFO sao convertido para absoluto caminhos em *OUTPUT.

original: Set *YOUNGEST_REV and *OLDEST_REV to the youngest and oldest revisions found in the rangelists within MERGEINFO. If MERGEINFO is NULL or empty set *YOUNGEST_REV and *OLDEST_REV to SVN_INVALID_REVNUM.
pt: definir *YOUNGEST_REV and *OLDEST_REV para the youngest and mais antigo revisions encontrado em the rangelists dentro de MERGEINFO. se MERGEINFO e NULL ou vazio definir *YOUNGEST_REV and *OLDEST_REV para SVN_INVALID_REVNUM.

original: Set *FILTERED_MERGEINFO to a deep copy of MERGEINFO, allocated in RESULT_POOL, less any rangelists that fall outside of the range OLDEST_REV:YOUNGEST_REV (inclusive) if INCLUDE_RANGE is true, or less any rangelists within the range OLDEST_REV:YOUNGEST_REV if INCLUDE_RANGE is false. If all the rangelists mapped to a given path are filtered then filter that path as well. If all paths are filtered or MERGEINFO is empty or NULL then *FILTERED_MERGEINFO is set to an empty hash. Use SCRATCH_POOL for any temporary allocations.
pt: definir *FILTERED_MERGEINFO para a profundo copiar de MERGEINFO, alocado em RESULT_POOL, menos qualquer rangelists esse queda fora de the intervalo OLDEST_REV:YOUNGEST_REV (inclusive) se INCLUDE_RANGE e verdadeiro, ou menos qualquer rangelists dentro de the intervalo OLDEST_REV:YOUNGEST_REV se INCLUDE_RANGE e falso. se todo o rangelists mapeado para a dado caminho sao filtrado entao filtro esse caminho tambem. se todos caminhos sao filtrado ou MERGEINFO e vazio ou NULL entao *FILTERED_MERGEINFO e definir para an vazio hash. usar SCRATCH_POOL para qualquer temporario alocacoes.

original: Filter each mergeinfo in CATALOG as per svn_mergeinfo__filter_mergeinfo_by_ranges() and put a deep copy of the result in *FILTERED_CATALOG, allocated in RESULT_POOL. original: Adjust in-place MERGEINFO's rangelists by OFFSET. If OFFSET is negative and would adjust any part of MERGEINFO's source revisions to 0 or less, then those revisions are dropped. If all the source revisions for a merge source path are dropped, then the path itself is dropped. If all merge source paths are dropped, then *ADJUSTED_MERGEINFO is set to an empty hash. *ADJUSTED_MERGEINFO is allocated in RESULT_POOL. SCRATCH_POOL is used for any temporary allocations.
pt: ajustar em-lugar MERGEINFO's rangelists por OFFSET. se OFFSET e negativo and iria ajustar qualquer parte de MERGEINFO's fonte revisions para 0 ou menos, entao aqueles revisions sao descartado. se todo o fonte revisions para a mesclar fonte caminho sao descartado, entao the caminho proprio e descartado. se todos mesclar fonte caminhos sao descartado, entao *ADJUSTED_MERGEINFO e definir para an vazio hash. *ADJUSTED_MERGEINFO e alocado em RESULT_POOL. SCRATCH_POOL e usado para qualquer temporario alocacoes.

It avoids the table memory use (about 400 bytes) but the function is longer (about 200 bytes extra) and likely to be slower when the string is valid. If the string is invalid this function may be faster since it returns immediately rather than continuing to the end of the string. The main reason this function exists is to test the table driven implementation.
